ours.title: The Unbothered at Work

ours.title: The Fvnny Stoic
ours.subtitle: Unbothered Volume 10
ours.blurb: How to be unbothered in the agentic age. One hundred practices in EN/FR/PL/ES; the Polish edition, Zabawny Stoik, was once shelved separately as Vol. IX.

ours.title: AI Engineering In a Nutshell
ours.subtitle: A practitioner's field memoir
ours.blurb: Building agentic platforms for real clients, on a real budget, in real mornings. 100 chapters across 10 parts — from the 20-hour week to the system that runs itself.

ours.title: Claude Certified Architect
ours.subtitle: The Field Guide
ours.blurb: One hundred chapters on shipping with Claude — the exam under one arm, the working system under the other. Pro tips and diagrams throughout, across ten parts.

ours.title: The Margins
ours.subtitle: An Unbothered Reading List
ours.blurb: One hundred non-fiction books ranked across ten shelves — Mind, Money, History, Science, Habits, Work, Society, Tech, Bodies, Meaning. One editorial plate and one thing to try per spread.

ours.title: Top 100 Decision Models for Strategic Thinking
ours.subtitle: One hundred ways to think before you choose
ours.blurb: One hundred decision models, from the Eisenhower Matrix to the Decision Journal: what each one is, how it works, a worked example, where it misleads and a two-minute exercise. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed diagram and one short film per model.

ours.title: The Unbothered Machine
ours.subtitle: How one person runs a hundred apps with AI agents (and stays calm about it)
ours.blurb: The operating manual for a company of one, staffed by AI agents. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter, plus the 10-template Machine Kit.

ours.title: Claude Code: The Ultimate Guide 2026
ours.subtitle: Delegate the work, keep the judgement
ours.blurb: The complete practitioner's manual for Claude Code in 2026: every surface, every extension point, and how to work with an agent that writes the code. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Visual Encyclopaedia of AI
ours.subtitle: 100 chapters. 10 topics. Everything that matters.
ours.blurb: The book edition of the KnowledgAI app: what machine intelligence is, where it came from, how it works and where it is going. 100 chapters across 10 topics, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Context Window
ours.subtitle: What a model can see, and how to choose it
ours.blurb: A practitioner's field guide to context engineering: what a model can actually see, how it reads, and how to choose what goes in front of it, from system prompts and retrieval to compaction, caching and multi-agent work. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: Thinking Clearly
ours.subtitle: A Story in 100 Diagrams
ours.blurb: How a mind gets foggy and how it clears, told in 100 short chapters and 100 detailed diagrams: first principles, the biases in the mirror, mental models, thinking in bets, argument, decisions, attention, writing to think and the clear mind. Funny-stoic, practical, unbothered.

ours.title: The Solo Agency
ours.subtitle: One person, a team of agents, and clients who never notice the difference
ours.blurb: The operating manual for an agency of one in the AI era: what to sell, how to win and onboard clients, how agents do the production while you keep the judgement and the relationships, and how to stay solvent, sane and small on purpose. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: Evals in a Nutshell
ours.subtitle: Measuring what your AI actually does
ours.blurb: A vendor-neutral field guide to evaluating LLM applications and agents: datasets, graders, judges, statistics, RAG, tools, CI, production and red teams, and the habits that keep quality honest. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Authority Book
ours.subtitle: How a 100-entry book wins clients
ours.blurb: A field guide for consultants, coaches, agencies and expert-led firms on writing a 100-entry branded book that does the selling before the first meeting: niche, entries, structure, AI-assisted production, design, editions, launch and the sales conversation. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Librarian
ours.subtitle: 100 principles for organising knowledge
ours.blurb: A field guide to personal and team knowledge management in the AI era: capture, naming, structure, search, decay, and making what you know legible to people and agents alike. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Micro-Consulting Playbook
ours.subtitle: Small AI engagements that clients say yes to
ours.blurb: How to scope, shape, deliver and prove small, fixed-scope AI engagements built with Claude, from the paid audit to the agent pilot, and how to turn each one into the next. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: Agents in Production
ours.subtitle: Shipping AI agents that survive Monday morning
ours.blurb: A practitioner's engineering guide to taking LLM agents from a dazzling demo to a dull, dependable production system: architecture, tools, context, state, guardrails, security, budgets, observability, evaluation, rollout and incident response. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The MCP Field Guide
ours.subtitle: Connecting models to the world, one server at a time
ours.blurb: A practitioner's guide to the Model Context Protocol: why it exists, how it works on the wire, how to build, secure, ship and govern servers, and why a protocol is a promise between strangers. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Operator’s Handbook
ours.subtitle: Running a one-person machine with AI agents, day by day
ours.blurb: The operating manual for the solo operator who runs a fleet of AI agents: the daily rhythm, the briefs, the memory, the register, the review and the release, and the thesis that the job is deciding, not doing. 100 chapters across 10 parts, one diagram per chapter.

ours.title: The Top 100 Diagrams That Changed the World
ours.subtitle: A diagram is an argument you can see
ours.blurb: From Ptolemy's grid to the Transformer: one hundred diagrams that moved borders, cured cities, built machines and rewired how we think. 100 chapters across 10 parts, each with a detailed plate and a narrated film on the Top 100 cube site.

ours.title: Knowledge
ours.subtitle: The Visual Encyclopaedia of everything: 100 chapters, 10 subjects
ours.blurb: The opening volume of The Visual Encyclopaedia: space, Earth, life, the human body, matter and energy, inventions, the ancient and modern worlds, arts and culture, and the ideas that hold society together. 100 chapters in 10 parts, a detailed diagram for every chapter.

ours.title: World History
ours.subtitle: 100 turning points, from the first humans to the age of AI
ours.blurb: The book edition of The World History 100: the story of humankind in date order, from the walk out of Africa to the age of AI. 100 chapters in 10 parts, a detailed plate for every chapter.

ours.title: Noted. Next.
ours.subtitle: The two-word habit that stops everything getting to you
ours.blurb: Everything gets to you: the email, the comment, the 3 a.m. thought. This book gives you two words to carry: Noted, to name what happened and stop arguing with it, and Next, to take the smallest step that is actually yours. Around them, a simple system: the Three Rooms (yours, theirs, the weather), better defaults, a calmer body, saner work and a way through hard days. 100 short chapters, 100 detailed diagrams, a Noted/Next box at the end of every one.

ours.title: History
ours.subtitle: How we know the past, and the story of everything we made
ours.blurb: The thematic companion to World History: how historians know what they know, then the long story of writing, money, war, law, medicine, food, building, travel and everyday life, each from its earliest evidence to today. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: Science
ours.subtitle: How we found out how the world works
ours.blurb: The discovery-led companion to Knowledge: one hundred big ideas in science, each told through the experiment, observation or instrument that revealed it, from atoms and forces to genes, climate and the expanding universe. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Human Story
ours.subtitle: 100 turning points that made us who we are
ours.blurb: The book edition of The Human Story in 100: the story of our species told through the people who lived it, from the first upright steps to thinking machines. What each turning point did to our bodies, minds, families, food, work and lifespans, and how we know. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Brain
ours.subtitle: 100 chapters on the organ that makes you you
ours.blurb: The brain at depth, from a single neuron to the sense of self: the cells and chemistry, the regions, the senses, movement, memory, emotion, language, sleep and dreams, what goes wrong, and how we read, mend and imitate brains, AI included. How it works, and how we know. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: Dinosaurs
ours.subtitle: 100 discoveries from the age of dinosaurs
ours.blurb: The Mesozoic told the way modern palaeontologists see it: evidence first. From the first fossil hunters to the asteroid, from Triassic dawn runners to sauropod giants, feathered raptors and the 11,000 species of dinosaur still alive as birds. Named specimens, real sites and how we know. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Human Body
ours.subtitle: How the body is built and how it works, in 100 chapters
ours.blurb: The Visual Encyclopaedia, No. 7: how the human body is built and how it works, from a single cell to a whole lifespan. Skeleton, heart, lungs, gut, brain, senses, immunity, hormones and ageing, with the striking numbers and how we found out. 100 chapters in 10 parts, a detailed plate for every chapter.

ours.title: Astronomy
ours.subtitle: 100 chapters on the sky, the stars and the universe
ours.blurb: The book edition of The Visual Encyclopaedia of Astronomy: the whole sky explained, from the stars you can see tonight to the edge of the observable universe. How each thing works, with real numbers and scale, and how we know it, from Stonehenge to the James Webb Space Telescope. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Oceans
ours.subtitle: 100 chapters on the water that covers our world
ours.blurb: The sea from top to bottom: how the ocean formed and moves, its layers from the sunlit shallows to the hadal trenches, the life that fills it, its coasts and reefs, the explorers who charted it, the people who live by it, its role in our climate and the fight to save it. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Vegetable Kingdom
ours.subtitle: 100 chapters on the green world that feeds us
ours.blurb: The plant world from root to flower: what a plant is, how plants evolved from algae to orchids, how they are built, how they turn light into life, how they reproduce, the trees and forests, the deserts, mountains and islands they fill, the crops we domesticated, the medicines, fibres and flavours we take from them, the botanists who studied them, and the threats and future of the green kingdom. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: Claude Enterprise
ours.subtitle: Rolling out Claude across an organisation, safely and usefully
ours.blurb: How to bring Claude to a whole organisation and make it count: what the Enterprise plan includes, buying and scoping it, identity and access, data and security, connectors, skills and plugins, Cowork and agentic work, Claude Code at company scale, rolling it out department by department, governance and spend, and measuring what actually changed. 100 chapters in 10 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: The Agentic Native Organisation
ours.subtitle: One rule, five waits, one fleet, three tiers
ours.blurb: How a small human team beside a standing fleet of AI agents ships most of its work, and how to adopt the method without borrowing the risk. One rule, find the wait and remove it, applied five times: agents talking to agents, the pull-request queue, humans relaying production, the release window and the founder's own taste. 25 short chapters in 5 parts, one detailed plate per chapter.

ours.title: Sapiens++
ours.subtitle: From Stardust to the Intelligence We Build
ours.blurb: Hold out your hand. Most of its hydrogen is older than the stars; its grip was shaped in trees; it can now ask a machine to act while it rests. Sapiens++ follows that hand through ten parts and a hundred chapters: cosmic ingredients, life, bodies, minds, language, tools, institutions, machines, intelligence we build, and what Human++ should mean. Every chapter ends with an Evidence box that says what is established, what is debated and what is still open. One detailed plate per chapter.
